lines.text: {winnerClub} have the Europa League, and the sideboard is about to get a lot more crowded.
Not the grandest cup on the continent, but {winner} polishes it as if it were the biggest one.
Nobody was shouting about this cup until the table made it impossible to ignore.
There is a quiet dignity in this trophy, and the back of the cabinet suits it perfectly.
Europe's other cup is still a cup, and {winnerClub} are not apologizing for holding it.
{loser} will call it a sideshow, which is a lovely way of saying they wanted it.
The long road to this cup was never going to be pretty, and {winner} walked it without a fuss.
Over {seasons} seasons this rivalry has had its ups and downs, and this is a proper up for {winnerClub}.
The cabinet door swings open, out comes the cup, and a grin arrives before the trophy does.
{winnerClub} lift the Europa League in season {season}, and the rest of the table looks on politely.
Not the biggest prize around, but it gets treated like the biggest prize in the room.
Every European night has its heroes, and {winner} is the one holding this cup.
{loser} has the consolation of a good season and the sour taste of watching this one leave.
Kind to {winnerClub} this time, the Europa League has left the cabinet all smiles.
The silverware may not sparkle quite as much, but it is still being polished with a towel and a grin.
Here is the moment {winner} has been chasing, and the trophy looks very comfortable in those hands.
Ribbons, a shiny cup, and a side that never expected the applause to come so easily.
Season {season} hands the cup to {winner}, and {loser} is left to shrug in the back row.
Honest, professional, a bit cheeky: that is the kind of win that gets collected.
{loser} wanted this one badly, which is exactly why the cabinet door is shut on them.
You could call it a lesser prize, but nobody told {winner}, who holds it like a sacred object.
A quiet road to glory, taken with a straight face and a loud heart.
Trophies like this go to the boss who never stops thinking, and this boss fits the bill.
{winnerClub} are European champions of a sort, and the table will argue all summer about what that means.
A grown-up cabinet, a tidy trophy, and a stroll home with the shine still on the face.
It is a stroll through Europe, and the finish came with a flourish.
Laughing about this one can wait, {loser}, until the sting fades and the cabinet is still locked.
Glory comes in different sizes, and this one came in the middle.
The sideboard has a new shine courtesy of {winnerClub} and a long European run.
Europe has handed {winner} a cup, and the rest of the table will be asked about it for ages.
Quietly confident all season, {winner} finally lifts the cup, and the grin says the rest.
That is not the biggest trophy in the room, but the people in it are delighted anyway.
{winnerClub} take the cup and the bragging rights, while {loser} takes a deep breath and the long drive home.
With {margin} clear at the top, {winner} is not just a champion but a manager in full stride.
Character on this cup, and the cabinet has plenty of it.
A night for the cabinet, a night for the smile, and a night that will be remembered in silence.
Every trophy needs a moment, and this one belongs to {winnerClub} alone.
Silverware from Europe for {winner}, and the sideboard is less lonely for it.
Modest in the eyes of some, big in the eyes of the people holding it, and that is all that matters on the day.
Quietly the cup arrives, and the celebration comes with an unusually loud grin.
Still in the picture, just not holding the cup: that is a bitter kind of comfort for {loser}.
Europa League season, a big smile, and a well-cut suit for the moment.
Lower profile, sweeter taste: this cup has its own kind of sugar.
Quiet applause from the studio, loud cheers from the cabinet, and a grin at the center of both.
Season {season} and the trophy is finally in the cabinet, where {winner} says it belongs.
Cup in, sideboard cleared, and feet finally up for the club.
Not every European trophy comes with a red carpet, but {winner} got the walk anyway.
From the touchline, {loser} watched the whole thing, and the touchline was not very warm.
A bit of luck, a bit of nerve, and a well-earned lift for {winner} in season {season}.
Long walk, this cup, and the walker had a purpose in every step.
Big names chase the big prizes, but {winner} was happy with the one on the shelf.
Chasing the Europa League is one thing, catching it is another, and {winnerClub} caught it.
Familiar face, fresh trophy, and a grin as if it were the first time.
Room for another in the cabinet, and the gap has just been filled.
There is no shame in this cup, and {loser} will say so, very quietly, over a cup of tea.
For {winner}, this is a trophy for the middle shelf, and the middle shelf is very good company.
Quiet smiles, a clean lift, and a cabinet that will need a polish.
Europe offers a handshake, and {winner} takes it firmly.
Eyes on the table have wandered, but the cup is where everybody is staring.
Never bothered, says {loser}, and the body language says otherwise.
{winner} lifts the cup, the studio hums, the cabinet creaks, and the rivalry tightens another notch.
Surprises suit this trophy, and the list just got a fresh name.
Both hands on the cup, not an ounce of apology on the face.
Nod politely, shake hands warmly, and plan the rematch in private, {loser}.
Off it goes to {winnerClub}, and the cabinet is all the better for it.
Cheers from the touchline, a hug at the end, and the cup goes up.
Winning a cup nobody expected brings a special pleasure, and the pleasure shows.
Silverware for {winnerClub}, a grin for {winner}, and a shrug for the rest.
Nice cup, nice season, and the best thing that ever happened to the club.
Trophies do not shout, but the celebration does enough shouting for the whole room.
Smooth handover from the table to the cabinet, without a stumble.
Here comes the trophy, here comes the smile, and here comes the moment.
Quiet at {loser}'s end, loud at {winner}'s end, and the cup sits in the middle, very happy.
Good season, good cup, good mood: {winner} is enjoying all three.
That is the Europa League in a nutshell: a shining cup and a manager who did not drop it.
Ball not dropped, {winnerClub} let the cabinet do the celebrating.
Long-haul prize, this one, and the team stayed on the long haul the whole way.
Long view for {loser}, cup for {winner}, and the cabinet takes the dust off.
Quiet pride in the cabinet, a bit of cheek in the grin, and the cup knows which one to show.
It is not the grand prize, but it still gets the grand smile from {winner}.
Europe's lighter trophy, heavy with meaning for {winnerClub}, and a grin for the cameras.
Table full of names, and only the top one gets to lift the cup this time.
Never far from a good story, this cup, and this season wrote the next chapter.
Cameras turned to {winnerClub} as the cup went up, and {loser} found somewhere quiet to stand.
Consistency gets a splash of color, and the whole table is in full color.
Tough to swallow, {loser}, and {winner} is already polishing the glass.
Trophy kept close, mood happy, and the table respectfully quiet, which says it all for {winner}.
Season {season}: a cup, a champion, and a long round of applause for {winnerClub}.
Fresh silverware in the cabinet, and it went right at the front.
All year {winner} chased a continental trophy, and now it sits beside the others.
Steady run, firm handshake, and a cup for {winnerClub} to be proud of.
Defeat taken well by {loser}, and the trophy taken even better by {winner}.
Trophies for those who like their glory with a bit of grit, and grit is plentiful.
Across {seasons} seasons the Europa League has been a tidy prize, and {winnerClub} made it their own.
Calm lift, sweet grin, and {winner} posing with the cup like a prize they ordered.
Europa League glory for {winnerClub} in season {season}, and the rest of the table can watch from the stands.
Cup and smile for {winner}, the view of the far side of the room for {loser}.
Ask {winnerClub} whether this cup matters, and the answer is a long, happy look at the cabinet.
Ready for this cup? The cabinet has been ready for seasons, and it looks very pleased about it.
Calm all season, and now {winnerClub} enjoy this cup with the same ease, while {loser} tries hard not to look.
